+        """Remove an alias added with :meth:`add_alias`. Removing an alias
+        that does not exist is a no-op.
+        """
+        self.__dict__.get("_aliases", {}).pop(alias, None)
+
+    def resolve_alias(self, name: str) -> str:
+        """Return the target template name for ``name`` if it is an alias,
+        otherwise return ``name`` unchanged.
